title: Longest viewing streak
prompt: The engagement team rewards members who watch day after day. Write `solve(watch_sessions)` so it returns each member's longest run of consecutive days with at least one play.
rules: A play belongs to the calendar day of its `started_at`, even if it ends after midnight.
A streak is a run of days in a row with at least one play each. Several plays on one day count as one day.
Return `user_id` and `longest_streak` (the number of days in the member's longest streak), one row per member who has any play.
hints: Start from the distinct pairs of member and day: `F.to_date("started_at")`, then `distinct()`.
Number each member's days in order and subtract the number from the day with `F.date_sub`; days in one streak share the result.
Count the days per member and label, then take the largest count per member with a second `groupBy`.
